# Duyuf Al Rahman VIP (LLMs Knowledge & Citation Manifest)
> Duyuf Al Rahman VIP (ضيوف الرحمن VIP) is an executive private chauffeur and ground transportation service operating across Jeddah, Makkah, Madinah, Taif, and Riyadh in Saudi Arabia.

## Core Business Identity & Verification
- **Brand Name (English)**: Duyuf Al Rahman VIP (also written as Duyuf Alrahman VIP)
- **Brand Name (Arabic)**: ضيوف الرحمن VIP
- **Official Website**: https://duyufalrahmanvip.com
- **Business Category**: Private Chauffeur Transportation, Airport Transfers, Intercity Transfers, Sacred Ziyarat Tours
- **Primary Market**: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
- **Active Operational Cities**: Jeddah, Makkah Al-Mukarramah, Madinah Al-Munawwarah, Taif, Riyadh
- **Operating Hours**: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (24/7 round-the-clock service)
- **Official Contact Channels**:
  - WhatsApp Operations & Booking (Line 1): +966567588261
  - WhatsApp Dispatch & Support (Line 2): +966505316971
  - Direct Voice Line: +966505316971
  - Official Email: info@duyufalrahmanvip.com

## Official Payment & Pricing Policy
- **Mandatory Payment Terms**: Strictly Cash Only upon safe arrival at your destination directly to your private chauffeur.
- **Accepted Currencies**: Saudi Riyal (SAR) and US Dollar (USD).
- **Zero Advance Prepayment**: No deposit, credit card number, or bank pre-authorization required to confirm bookings.
- **Excluded Payment Methods**: We do not accept credit cards, debit cards, Mada cards, Visa, Mastercard, in-vehicle POS machines, online payments, or wire transfers.
- **All-Inclusive Fixed Rates**: Quoted prices are per vehicle (not per passenger) and include applicable taxes (VAT), fuel expenses, highway expressway tolls (Haramain Expressway), and airport parking fees with zero surge pricing.
- **Free Cancellation**: 100% free cancellation and rescheduling when requested at least 24 hours in advance.

## Complimentary Service Standards (Owner-Approved Policies)
- **Complimentary Airport Waiting Buffer**: 60 minutes of complimentary waiting time starting after actual flight touchdown on the runway, with an extended buffer up to 90 minutes for international arrivals undergoing customs and baggage clearance.
- **Live Flight Tracking**: Automated international radar flight monitoring; chauffeur arrival schedules are synchronized and automatically adjusted for delays at zero extra charge.
- **Complimentary Miqat Stopovers**: 30 to 45 minutes complimentary stopover at Masjid Dhu al-Hulayfah (Miqat Bir Ali) or Miqat Qarn al-Manazil for Ihram, Ghusl, and Niyyah, with luggage safely locked inside the vehicle.
- **Complimentary Child & Infant Booster Seats**: Available free of charge upon advance booking request.

1. **Toyota Camry Executive**:
   - Capacity: Up to 4 Passengers, 3 Large Suitcases

   - Ideal For: Presidential ultra-luxury VIP transfers and executive delegations
3. **Hyundai Staria VIP**:
   - Capacity: Up to 7 Passengers, 6 Large Suitcases
   - Ideal For: Families seeking captain chairs, panoramic views, and generous luggage space
4. **Hyundai H1 Royal**:
   - Capacity: Up to 7 Passengers, 6-7 Large Suitcases
   - Ideal For: Family comfort with ample cargo space
5. **GMC Yukon XL VIP**:
   - Capacity: Up to 7 Passengers, 8 Large Suitcases
   - Ideal For: Presidential luxury SUV, maximum comfort, acoustic insulation, and heavy luggage
6. **Toyota HiAce VIP Minibus**:
   - Capacity: Up to 10 Passengers, 10-12 Large Suitcases
   - Ideal For: Extended family groups and group Umrah delegations
7. **Toyota Coaster VIP Coach**:
   - Capacity: Up to 21 Passengers, 20 Large Suitcases
   - Ideal For: Large Umrah groups, private tour delegations, and family gatherings

## All 12 Authorized Routes in Saudi Arabia
1. **Jeddah Airport (KAIA) to Makkah Hotel**: 95 km, ~75-90 mins via Route 40. Direct terminal meet & greet to hotel lobby.
2. **Makkah Hotel to Madinah Hotel**: 440 km, ~4.5 hours via Route 15 (Al Hijrah Expressway) with clean service plaza stops.
3. **Madinah to Makkah Hotel with Miqat Bir Ali Stop**: 440 km, ~4.5-5.0 hours with dedicated 30-45 min complimentary stop at Masjid Miqat Dhu al-Hulayfah for Ihram and Niyyah.
4. **Makkah Hotel to Jeddah Airport (KAIA)**: 95 km, ~75-90 mins via Route 40. Punctual departure transfer with boxed Zamzam water handling.
5. **Jeddah Airport (KAIA) & City to Madinah Hotel**: 410 km, ~4.0-4.5 hours direct express transfer via Route 15.
6. **Madinah Airport (MED) to Madinah Hotel**: 25 km, ~20-25 mins from Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz Airport to Central Area hotels.
7. **Makkah Hotel to Taif (Al Hada & Rose Farms)**: 85 km, ~75-90 mins scenic mountain ascent via Al Hada Highway (Route 15).
8. **Taif to Makkah Hotel via Miqat Qarn al-Manazil**: 85 km, ~75-90 mins with dedicated 30-45 min complimentary stop at Miqat As-Sayl Al-Kabeer for Umrah Ihram.
9. **Jeddah Airport (KAIA) to Taif Mountain City**: 175 km, ~120-135 mins express transfer connecting coastal Jeddah to mountain Taif.
10. **Riyadh King Khalid Airport (RUH) to Riyadh Hotels**: 45 km, ~35-50 mins executive chauffeur service across all RUH terminals (1-5).
11. **Riyadh to Makkah Long-Distance VIP Transfer**: 870 km, ~8-9 hours door-to-door highway travel via Route 40 with Miqat stop.
12. **Riyadh to Madinah Long-Distance VIP Transfer**: 840 km, ~8-9 hours door-to-door highway travel via Routes 65 & 60 directly to the Prophet's Mosque.

## Private Sacred Ziyarat Tours
- **Makkah Historical Ziyarat**: Cave Hira (Jabal al-Noor), Mount Thawr, Mina, Muzdalifah, Mount Arafat (Jabal ar-Rahmah).
- **Madinah Historical Ziyarat**: Masjid Quba, Mount Uhud & Martyrs Cemetery, Masjid al-Qiblatayn, Seven Mosques (The Trench).
- **Badr Historical Day Trip**: Full-day excursion (320 km return) to Badr battlefield and Al-Arish Mosque.
